title: Autonomy in Check: Governor-Mediated Adaptive Security at the Edge
abstract: arXiv:2609.18338v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adaptive security at the network edge increasingly relies on automated planners, including rule-based controllers, learned policies, and LLM-assisted agents, that translate observations into enforcement actions. Once such a planner can influence live policy state, syntactic validity is not enough. A semantically wrong action, produced from incomplete or manipulated observations, can be faithfully executed by an enforcement substrate that cannot judge mission context. We address this problem by treating the boundary between planner output and kernel enforcement input as the primary security object. We propose a split-control architecture in which an untrusted planner emits typed security intents, a deterministic governor checks each intent against safety, resource, temporal-stability, and proportionality invariants, and only admitted actions are bound to signed receipts and compiled into pre-installed eBPF map updates. translated_title: 自治受控：基于治理器的边缘自适应安全
translated_abstract: 网络边缘的自适应安全越来越依赖于自动规划器，包括基于规则的控制器、学习型策略以及LLM辅助的智能代理，它们将观测结果转化为执行动作。一旦这样的规划器能够影响实时策略状态，仅靠语法有效性是不够的：由不完整或被操纵的观测产生的语义错误动作，可能被无法判断任务上下文的执行基础设施忠实地执行。我们通过将规划器输出与内核执行输入之间的边界作为主要安全对象来解决这一问题。我们提出了一种分权控制架构，其中不受信任的规划器发出类型化的安全意图，由一个确定性的治理器根据安全、资源、时间稳定性和相称性等不变量对每个意图进行检查，只有被接纳的动作才会绑定签名回执并被编译为预安装的eBPF映射更新。本文对该架构进行了形式化……
tldr: 该论文提出一种分权控制架构，由确定性治理器对不受信任规划器（包括LLM代理）发出的安全意图进行安全、资源、时间稳定性与相称性不变量校验，只有通过校验的动作才经签名回执绑定并编译为eBPF映射更新加以执行，从而在边缘自适应安全中解决了语义错误动作可能被忠实执行的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a split-control architecture in which a deterministic governor checks typed security intents from untrusted planners (including LLM agents) against safety, resource, temporal-stability, and proportionality invariants, ensuring only admitted actions are bound to signed receipts and compiled into eBPF map updates, thereby preventing semantically wrong actions from being faithfully enforced at the edge.
